how: A starter reports beginning an AU while inviting others to join.
Requests repeatedly recruit helpers for starting, taking space, and defending a shared mark.
Members propose an AU logo and affirm that it is their target.
Members report single pixels, slow placing, progress, and a logo finished near shutdown.
Questions about location receive coordinates while a late defender still requests a diagram.
Participants call for recovery, announce defense, and limit their commitment to a small AU.
A participant attributes an imperfect finish to Armenian interference without independently establishing that explanation.
A placer explicitly stops at contested space and another neighbor promises to stop expanding.
Participants negotiate a letter boundary, report permission, and contest a request to move.
Recruitment explicitly proposes converting defended RURURU into AUBURN.
A fresh AU start follows reports of lost attempts without proving collective relocation or its cause.
Participants celebrate a surviving result and thank helpers while another account qualifies its completeness.
Participants mourn overtaken attempts, mark shutdown, and later locate the surviving AU.
Locating the finished mark provides no evidence of deciding to carry the effort into a later venue or emblem.
Apparent extra placements are corrected as a display bug and establish no script, bot, or spare account use.
A short progress report answers a conditional offer to take the target without asking anything back.
A neighbor explicitly promises defensive help as thanks for a space concession.
A member reports helping greenlattice while requesting a spot, with no reply yet.
A member reports small alliances through permission for a small AU without demonstrating a larger coalition.
Participants salute their completed dispute as war games and diplomacy while another participant blames interference.
A member applies for an AU spot while helping a prospective host but reports no acceptance.
A member reports carrying a space agreement back from someone associated with another room.
Calls for helpers provide no coded evidence of moderators or members regulating canvas discussion.
Claiming permission to occupy space does not establish members disputing who may bind their room.
Near-finish regret does not establish contest over a cleaned copy, and uncoded material leaves that process unresolved.
A question about the activity and an answer directing the questioner to place establish no host-sub prank framing.
A participant judges that only a small AU can be defended and commits to that task.
Neither the conversion proposal nor later blame identifies an earlier quarrel carried onto the canvas.
Thanks for collective help expresses belonging to the existing family rather than only completion of a picture.
Voluntary public coordination cannot exclude decisions in optional chats or test the claim about prevalence across rooms.
The proposed conversion and later blame name no prior tie as the reason for attacking.
An orange-pixel report answers the starter's location instruction, supporting local uptake without revealing silent participants.
Starting and calling are bundled in one passage, so this record cannot establish distinct successive stages.
Reported building is followed by an explicit defense call, establishing sequence but not the proposed causal mechanism.
Negotiation can precede reciprocal defense and enable finishing rather than only follow upkeep against erosion.
A peace request receives an explicit promise to stop placing in the contested space.
Defense is visible but no coded passage establishes escalation to machine hands.
Completion reports and celebration coexist without establishing that a particular building report caused the celebration.
Loss is recorded during active attempts before another result is celebrated, so recording is not solely a sequel to celebration.
A later search for the surviving mark establishes no decision to carry the temporary effort onward.
Judged scarcity can narrow defense to the existing small mark while fighting continues instead of forcing relocation.
A design proposal and later diagram request do not show that posting a template settled the design.
A bare work report answers a conditional participation offer, while reasons for declining remain untested.
Reciprocal defense is explicitly linked to a concession rather than demonstrated to result from a shortage of defenders.
A neighbor names the space concession as the reason for returning defensive help.
A request for hands explicitly seeks to convert defended lettering, and a member conditionally offers to join.
No coded response restrains the RURURU attack, and the earlier D concession belongs to a different exchange.
No coded response to the RURURU proposal invokes a truce or negotiates instead of attacking.
The RURURU attack and Armenian post-fight talk concern different opponents and cannot establish this causal succession.
A reported small alliance and a defense call do not establish defensive strain causing coalition entry.
Repeated calls have no coded sequel regulating host-sub discussion, which leaves the predicted mechanism unobserved.
Space permission and refusal to move do not establish an agreement provoking disagreement over who binds a room.
Members check apparent multi-pixel gains by refreshing and correct a progress report when its changes will disappear.
Requesting or claiming permission supports authorization talk but cannot establish continuing residence under an enforcing host.

statement: opening optional chat coordination alongside public reports
how: Internal chat invitations provide a coordination route without demonstrating a coalition, accepted migration, or visible chat decisions.

statement: ending an unsettled space dispute when placement stops
how: Shutdown explicitly removes the practical point of a permission dispute without showing that either party accepted the other's claim.
A neighbor explicitly stops expanding so the room can finish its work.
